data_output.description: The fixed training command must write predictions_valid.npz containing exactly two arrays: row_ids, an int64 array equal to np.arange(number_of_validation_rows) in canonical validation row order, and scores, a finite float array of identical length aligned one-to-one with row_ids. No ground-truth labels may be written or loaded by the training command; ground truth is loaded only by the fixed evaluator.

model_input.description: model.py receives encoded feature matrices with columns [user_id_index, video_id_index] in the existing additive-plus-16-dimensional interaction architecture. It must expose the existing training/prediction/state interface, initialize user_embeddings and item_embeddings from a deterministic seeded normal distribution with standard deviation 0.01, and implement BPR updates by sampling at most one long_view-positive and one long_view-negative training impression from the same eligible user per update unit. Users lacking either class are skipped. For each pair, optimize softplus(score_negative-score_positive), while preserving additive weights, dimensions, optimizer settings, data split, validation checkpointing, and prediction shape.
